subject: Startup onboarding credit amendment for BlueNova
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@bluenova.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Startup onboarding credit amendment for BlueNova

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BlueNova’s generative search pilot looks like a great fit for our small-startup tier and accelerator program. You mentioned in the call that the BlueNova Accelerator handbook references a $50k onboarding credit for accepted startups, but the intake form you submitted listed a different billing cadence (monthly usage credits).

Quick question: are you asking for a one-time onboarding credit that applies to first invoices, or would you prefer a monthly promotional credit applied over the first 3 months? I want to confirm the exact ask so I can route for approval.

Attached is the copy of the BlueNova application you uploaded — I included it for context.

Next steps I can take depending on what you want:
- If one-time credit: I’ll request an exception and propose a one-off promo credit amount.
- If monthly credit: I’ll propose a time-limited monthly credit schedule and outline the minimum commitment terms we’d need.

Can you confirm preference and timeline for the pilot? If you want the one-time route, we’ll need a brief committed spend (example: $60k over 12 months) to justify the exception — happy to propose specifics once you confirm.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: bluenova-accelerator-application.pdf (application summary)

From: Alex Chen <alex@bluenova.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Startup onboarding credit amendment for BlueNova

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the quick follow up.

Sorry for the ambiguity. The Accelerator handbook lists $50k in platform credits but that’s intended as a pool and historically teams ask for a portion up front to cover pilot usage. For our pilot we’d like a $30k one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice to cover model usage during the 6–8 week proof-of-concept. After that we expect normal monthly consumption of ~2–3k/month while we integrate.

We are comfortable with a light commitment to make the exception workable — happy to discuss a 12-month minimum ARR commitment if that’s Redwood’s standard approach for exceptions. We’d like to close terms this week if possible so we can start ingesting data.

— Alex
Alex Chen, Co-founder & CTO
BlueNova Labs
alex@bluenova.io

Folks —

Looping you in on BlueNova (startup from the BlueNova Accelerator). They’re requesting a $30k one-time onboarding credit to cover the initial pilot; they’re open to a 12-month minimum commitment.

Details:
- External: Alex Chen (Co-founder, BlueNova) — alex@bluenova.io
- Ask: $30k one-time credit applied to first invoice; pilot ~6–8 weeks; ongoing consumption ~2–3k/mo after pilot
- Proposed counter: one-time $25k credit contingent on signed 12-month MRA with minimum committed spend of $60k/year (split monthly).

Attached a draft of the MRA language I usually use for these exceptions — I trimmed to the minimum commercial terms that Finance/Legal have accepted in the past. If Finance is ok I’ll send to legal and get DocuSign queued.

Can you comment quickly on: (1) is $25k acceptable instead of $30k, (2) is 12-month $60k commit sufficient, and (3) any billing/recognition concerns? They want to start ingestion next week so timing is tight.

Thanks —
Jasmine

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Startup onboarding credit amendment for BlueNova

Sounds reasonable. Approve a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 conditioned on:
- Signed MRA/Amendment (DocuSign) within 14 days
- Commit to $60k ARR (12-month term) or prepay equivalent for the first 6 months
- Credit applied to the first invoice after provisioning (non-refundable, cannot be converted to credits for other accounts)

Monica — any blocking accounting/recognition issues with applying credits this way for startups coming through accelerator channels? If not, fine to proceed.

Jasmine — send the amendment with the above bullet points; I’ll approve the exception and tag the deal in HubSpot (RINF-2026-0532). Keep the contact in the loop so we can expedite.

— Marcus

Subject: Final: BlueNova onboarding credit & next steps (MRA + DocuSign)

Hi Alex —

Good news: Redwood can approve a one-time onboarding promo credit of $25,000 to support BlueNova’s pilot. The credit is conditional on execution of a short amendment (MRA) that includes the following commercial bullets:
- One-time non-refundable onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to the first invoice after provisioning.
- Minimum commitment: $60,000 over 12 months (monthly invoicing).
- Term: 12 months from the effective date of the MRA.
- Billing: credit applied as contra-revenue on the first invoice; standard invoicing thereafter.

Action items:
1) I’ve uploaded the amendment to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/parts/abc123-amendment — please sign and we’ll provision access and apply the credit.
2) HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/BlueNova-Labs (deal RINF-2026-0532).
3) If you prefer, we can also accept a prepayment for the first 6 months in lieu of the commitment.

We aim to provision sandbox access within 48 hours of signature. Let me know if you want me to loop in a solutions engineer for a rapid ingestion session.

Thanks — excited to get BlueNova started.

Best,
